company.name: Entablet
company.shortDescription: Entablet, a startup specialized in tablet and mobile solutions and services.
company.description:
Entablet is a technology company specialized in Tablet and Mobile enchanting portfolio of solutions and services, with an engaging service catalog and an enormous service pipeline. Entablet has already produced several products: Tabvertise.com, enfleet and Tabpetit.
Tabvertise.com: Tabvertise is a digital media management solution that is developed and available for both Display panels and tablets network. It gives the administrator full control over all tablets, displays and contents broadcasted individually or in groups and clusters, and it can be managed over the Internet using any form of secure connection.
